title: The students' loop made continuous: retrain where homework grew, demote below the bar, the register's history per point
request: Phase 7 (the owner): a student behind every choice, kept up with its labels without anyone running a command; 29.7 in the plan's order after 29.3.
plan: A loop module whose one run rebuilds the workspace's sets, retrains the students whose homework grew by a margin, demotes a routed model below its bar and writes the register line.
A job kind queued by the worker's sweep after new labels (with a cooldown) or once a night; a failed run waits an hour.
The register reads each point's own student beside DCLab's; the history shows the new card; the Students page draws its trail.
Tests first: a first fit, growth past and below the margin, a planted slip demoted, the schedule, the job through a real worker.

decisions.decision: The loop trains the workspace's own students (own_models, 26.7), not DCLab's generated-set students.
decisions.why: DCLab's students learn only from construction labels by design (decision_models_build refuses other sources); a workspace's new labels are its own data and stay in its folder.

decisions.decision: Promotion is never the loop's: it only demotes, through the audited switch, by DCLab.
decisions.why: Promotion needs a sealed pass and a shadow measurement, a person's audited change (22.6); a loop that promoted would act on its own measurement.

decisions.decision: Retrain when the train and dev rows grew by a tenth and at least five rows, or shrank; a point without a card gets its first.
decisions.why: A fit per label would churn versions and reset every shadow measurement (a version starts again from zero labelled disagreements); a shrink means deleted rows, which must leave the model.
The safety step must never wait for a fit that fails (the review: a failing fit blocked it every hour).

decisions.decision: A model that serves above shadow is frozen: the loop leaves its files alone until a person moves it to shadow.
decisions.why: Fitting again in place replaced the routed version's file: the route then named a model that no longer loads, a silent, unaudited demotion (the review's high finding).

decisions.decision: The sweep reads a cheap label signature (file metadata, or one count query) and nothing inside the cooldown.
decisions.why: It runs every minute in every worker; parsing every label each time was the cost the review measured.

change: dclab_rnd/students_loop.py (new: due, sweep_due, failed, run under the students folder's lock, main); a job kind students in jobs/handlers.py, queued from the worker's retention thread; students.py reads own cards (own), keeps own and own_dev_accuracy in the register line and the history, drops a line that changed nothing; own_models.py: a pass belongs to the version that sat it, forget, set folders of points with no rows removed; ledger label_signature on files and PostgreSQL; the Students page shows the own student and its trail; tests/run_parallel.py turns the loop off for every test file.

findings.defect: The loop overwrote a routed own model's files.
findings.scenario: An own model passed its gate and was routed at level 3; six more projects were labelled and the loop fitted again: only the new version loaded while the route still named the old one.
findings.cause: Growth ignored the routing and own_models.fit writes the point's files in place.
findings.fix: A point whose route is an own model above shadow is frozen and said in waiting; a pass counts only for the version that sat the exam.
findings.impact: The rule would have answered silently where a person had routed a model, and the old pass could route a model with no file.

findings.defect: A fit error blocked the demotion.
findings.scenario: One point's fit raised RuntimeError: the run raised before the demotion, so a slipping routed model stayed at its level, run after run.
findings.cause: Demotion ran after training, and own_models.fit catches only ValueError.
findings.fix: Demotion first; each point fitted alone in its own try.

findings.defect: A failed fit left a model file whose hash no longer matched.
findings.scenario: After the failing run a fresh load returned only the other point's model while the card claimed the new version.
findings.cause: Files were written for every point before fitted.json was written once at the end.
findings.fix: One point per fit call: fitted.json is written after each.

findings.defect: The slipping pill vanished after one more run.
findings.scenario: Lines own@a 0.95, own@b 0.80 (slipped), then a nightly own@b 0.80: the page reads the last line, which no longer says slipped.
findings.cause: The loop writes a line every night and after labels; the history compared the last two lines whatever they were.
findings.fix: A line equal to the one before it on the card's fields is dropped from the history.

findings.defect: The command read an empty file ledger on a PostgreSQL workspace.
findings.scenario: python -m dclab_rnd.students_loop with DCLAB_DATABASE_URL set: the sets were rewritten empty and an all-zero register line written.
findings.cause: open_ledger(home) without the workspace id opens the file ledger.

findings.defect: Deleted labels left their sets and the model trained on them.
findings.scenario: A project deleted under retention: a point with no labels left kept its rows.jsonl and chat.jsonl and its model kept answering.
findings.cause: The export only wrote the points it found, and a shrink was never a reason to fit.
findings.fix: The export removes set folders of points with no rows; a shrink refits; a point with nothing left forgets its model (demoted first if it served); exam results are kept.
findings.impact: A deleted project's decisions would have stayed in the workspace's sets and in a model, against the retention rule.

findings.defect: A skipped point was tried again without growth.
findings.scenario: Fitted at N, later skipped at M: every run retried it.
findings.cause: The last count preferred the fit's over the skip's.
findings.fix: The last try counts, fitted or skipped; no card and not skipped means a first fit.

findings.defect: The sweep parsed every label every minute, and an unreadable ledger queued a run.
findings.scenario: Every worker of every workspace, every 60 seconds, even inside the cooldown.
findings.cause: The due check counted labels first.
findings.fix: The cooldown is checked before anything is read; a cheap label signature; an unreadable ledger is not due.

findings.defect: Two runs could fit into the same files at once.
findings.scenario: The command beside a job, or a job retried as stale while it still ran.
findings.cause: The job table holds one job per key, but the command does not go through it.
findings.fix: A run holds the students folder's lock.

findings.defect: The job's wiring and its failure path were untested, and test servers could retrain students.
findings.scenario: No test ran a students job through a worker; a test server alive for a minute with labels would queue a real fit.
findings.cause: Tests called run directly; the runner blanked the shadows but not the loop.
findings.fix: A test runs the job through a real worker (done, then a failing run settled with the hour's wait); the test runner sets DCLAB_STUDENTS_LOOP=0.

findings.defect: Another ledger on the same folder was read as every label deleted.
findings.scenario: The owner's make dev (PostgreSQL) and make notebook (files) share agent_runs: a files-mode run saw no labels, removed every set and forgot every own model, while the PostgreSQL route still named one at level 1.
findings.cause: Neither the loop's state nor the forget step knew which ledger the models learned from.
findings.fix: The state keeps the ledger's kind and workspace; another ledger is never due and the command refuses it until a person passes --adopt; a route naming an own model that is no longer here goes back to shadow, audited.
findings.impact: A passed, routed model would have been destroyed with its exam (its sealed rows already read once) and the rule would have answered silently under a route naming nothing.
alternatives: State kept per ledger: set aside, the models folder is one; two sources would overwrite each other's models.

findings.defect: Deleted rows could stay in a model.
findings.scenario: 38 of 40 projects deleted: the refit was skipped for too few tables and the old model, trained on all 40, kept whispering; a routed point that shrank stayed frozen with them.
findings.cause: A skipped refit left the old model, and a frozen point never looked at its homework.
findings.fix: A shrink that cannot be fitted again forgets the model; a routed point whose decisions shrank goes back to shadow first, then is fitted on what is left.

findings.defect: A demotion in the deletion path was missing from the run's record.
findings.scenario: Audited, but not in demoted nor in the run.recorded numbers.
findings.fix: Every route the loop moves back to shadow goes through one helper that also says it in demoted.

measurements.name: the loop's tests
measurements.gate: Done when: a new labelled decision retrains its student on the next run and the register shows the new card; a demotion happens when a planted slip crosses the bar
measurements.result: 13 tests pass: a first card in the register and its history; growth past the margin retrains and one project does not; a planted slip of 25 blind labels at a fifth right demoted with DCLab's audit row; the job through a real worker; another ledger refused until adopted
limits: Synthetic labels on one point; no real workspace has run the loop yet.

outcome: A workspace's own students now follow its labels by themselves: retrained when their homework grows, frozen while they serve, demoted below their bar by an audited change, their history on the Students page; promotion stays a person's switch.
lessons: A loop that writes files under a route must check the route first: a version replaced in place is a demotion nobody audited.
Put the safety step before the step that can fail.
A history read from a log that writes on a schedule must drop the lines that changed nothing, or every warning lasts one tick.
Know which source a model learned from before reading an empty source as a deletion: one folder may have two ledgers.
risks: A version retrained starts its shadow measurement again from zero: a point that keeps growing may never reach the labels it needs to act.
DCLab's generated-set students do not learn from a workspace's labels here: only the workspace's own students do.
